messages:
maya: Bringing up cicada-7b on devstg (FP16 -> int8). Quick sanity pass?
ryan: 👍 can you paste the minimal sanity prompts? I can run local perf.
maya: Sure — a few quick ones:
```
1) Summarize the following text in one line:
   'The quick brown fox jumps...'
2) Translate to French: 'Hello world'
3) Simple math: 'What is 23 * 47?'
```
zara: @maya also add edge cases: long context (~8k tokens), multi-step math / chain-of-thought, and a small code-generation prompt (python function).
sam: Ran int8 quant on node-a, quick numbers: latency ~86ms @512 tokens, mem ~24GB. Hit a failure on long-context where outputs get truncated repeatedly. Logs show `KV cache OOM` for certain prompts.
ryan: can you paste the quant command you used? e.g. `./quantize --model cicada --bits 8 --backend qkernel`
maya: used this: ```
./quantize --model cicada-7b --bits 8 --calib-samples 1000 --calib-mode perchannel --backend qkernel
# deploy: ./serve --model cicada-7b-quant8 --batch 8 --max-len 8192
```
onboard-bot: smoke-evals: basic-answer-checks PASSED (3/3). regression-math: FAILED (0/1) — see attached quick diff.
zara: math fail likely tokenization + KV misalignment after quant. Try disabling rotary caching and/or increase per-request scratch buffer. Also try per-head quant calibration.
maya: ok will re-run with `--rotary-cache=off` + per-head calib. Priority: keep in devstg only, do not promote to staging/prod until passes full QA. @ryan can you run FP16 baseline perf before I re-run?
ryan: baseline FP16 on same node: ~72ms @512 tokens. int8 run is +~19% latency but ~2x token cost improvement.
sam: noted, opening tiny PR with the config diffs (rotary off, scratch=2GB).
maya: checklist I'm recording here: 1) basic prompts sanity, 2) edge prompts (long context, math, code), 3) perf matrix FP16/int8/(try int4 later), 4) regression evals against saved prompt set, 5) memory/kv stability over 1 hour soak. If any fail -> block rollout.
ryan: :thumbsup: i'll add the perf rows to the onboarding doc and run the embed sanity later.
maya: thanks — will post results once re-run completes (ETA ~45m).
